lead: A closure held in an array can be handed to a `Core` member's `callable` option
body: , and a call through the holding variable lowers too. `foreach ($filters as callable $filter) { Core\Out::capture($body, {through: $filter}) }` over an `array<callable>` lowers and runs, because the call is `nvs_runtime::call_callable`, not a lowered `Call`. A `mixed` is not implicitly narrowed, so `array<string> $row = ["a", $cell]` over a `mixed $cell` is `E0401`.
